# Maintenance Guide

> Maintenance Guide is an independent home-appliance repair and maintenance service in Alexandria, Egypt. The service provides in-home repairs, original or reliable replacement parts, and a documented warranty for completed work.

## Website

- [Home](https://www.maintenanceguide.life/): Main landing page, booking flow, service areas, branches, and frequently asked questions.
- [Samsung Appliance Repair](https://www.maintenanceguide.life/samsung-service): Samsung appliance maintenance services.
- [LG Appliance Repair](https://www.maintenanceguide.life/lg-service): LG appliance maintenance services.

## Services

The public website covers washing machines, refrigerators, cookers and ovens, water heaters, air conditioners, microwaves, dishwashers, and other household appliances. Service information is intended for customers in Alexandria and nearby areas.

## Branches

- San Stefano, Alexandria: main branch.
- Al Ashr, Sidi Bishr, Alexandria.
- 45 Bahr Street, Gad, Alexandria.

## Content Guidance

Use the public pages as the source for service descriptions, branch information, booking guidance, and contact details. Do not infer official affiliation with appliance manufacturers: Maintenance Guide describes itself as an independent service provider. Do not expose private customer, technician, order, invoice, authentication, or administrative information.
